name: locker-pulse
description: Smart InPost point finder built as a focused technical assignment project.

scripts.db:generate: uv run --project apps/api prisma generate --schema packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:migrate: uv run --project apps/api prisma migrate dev --schema packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.db:push: uv run --project apps/api prisma db push --schema packages/database/prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.test: uv run --project apps/api pytest && npm run lint --workspace apps/web && npm run build --workspace apps/web
